della_package_metadata_collection: Read through the frozen candidate with_env.sh on the Della login host, using the same absolute shared conda environment path as the Slurm jobs.
della_platform_metadata_collection: The platform string in della-runtime.json describes that login host, not a per-case compute-node capture.
della_thread_settings: All five numerical thread environment variables set to1 in array.sbatch.
comparison_scope: Within-Della paired cases use the same shared software environment and CPU constraint but may run on different compute nodes. They are not claimed to run on one identical physical host.
